notes.title: Super Sportmatchen 2nd Anniversary Weeklong Deal of 90% off!
notes.content:
Hey sports fans!

We're celebrating Super Sportmatchen's 2nd Year Anniversary with a [b]MEGA discount[/b] of [b]90% off[/b] on Steam's Weeklong Deal! 

Offer runs from May 25th to May 31st! 

Grab your friends and see who has the fastest fingers and the steadiest hands! Gloat in your own competitive awesomeness! Imagine yourself at the top of the podium!

Winning isn't everything, but winners have more fun!

notes.title: Added support for Korean!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

We have some great news for all of you. While some parts of the world have been sportsing for some time now, we decided it's finally time to introduce the amazing country of Korea to the wonderful world of Super Sportmatchen. Starting today, we've added Korean language support to the game, and fully localized the achievements into Korean as well. We hope Korean gamers have an amazing time sportsing with their friends!

Let's sports!

- The Super Sportmatchen team
